documents.generated_document: CHIEF COMPLAINT: Follow-up diabetes and hypertension. He reports his home blood sugars have been running high, mostly in the 180-220 range fasting. He admits he has not been taking his Metformin regularly over the last two months because it causes significant abdominal cramping and diarrhea. He also notes a new symptom of tingling and numbness in both feet, which started about a month ago and is worse at night. Denies any chest pain, shortness of breath, or vision changes. His blood pressure has been good at home. ROS: General: No weight loss or fatigue. Endocrine: Positive for polyuria. Neuro: Positive for bilateral foot tingling. CV: Negative for orthopnea or edema.
